messages:
Sarah Choi: Quick flag — access review export shows 7 owner contestations for payments-kms. Two rows claim svc-team-payments, three claim @devon, two blank. :frowning:
Mike Barker: Ugh, which table/source? Did we pull from access-census or from iam-snapshot?
Sarah Choi: access-census CSV (s3://sec-exports/q1_review/payments-kms-owners.csv). I ran the sampling query earlier.
Mike Barker: can you paste the query you used?
Sarah Choi: ```sql
SELECT resource, role, suggested_owner, evidence_link
FROM access_census
WHERE resource LIKE '%payments-kms%'
ORDER BY resource;
```
Devon Liu: I'll take the disputed ones where suggested_owner='devon.liu' — will reconcile against service ownership docs and recent deploys.
Tess Ops: tagging @oncall because some keys are attached to prod-processor which is scheduled for rotation next week.
security-bot: Reminder: Quarterly access review due in 5 days. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/sec/access-reviews
Mike Barker: For contested owners we need explicit evidence: recent PRs, on-call rotations, infra-ownership in Okta. I'll sketch a tiny template to collect replies.
Sarah Choi: Template for owner response: ```Owner: <github handle>
Justification: <why owner>
Evidence: <link to PR/alert/infra-as-code>
Last access: <ISO datetime>
```
Devon Liu: I can mediate but need a final decision by EOD Thu. Volunteers to validate the 7 entries?
Tess Ops: I can do 3 (the prod-processor ones) by tomorrow morning.
Mike Barker: I'll take the remaining 4 after lunch. Plan to run a short log query to prove last access: ```bash
rg 'payments-kms|encrypt' /var/logs/access/*.log | head
```
Sarah Choi: Also found one ownerless key — I've filed ticket SEC-4981 to either assign or schedule removal if no owner replies within 7 days.
Devon Liu: If anyone disagrees with my mediation results, DM me specifics. Otherwise I'll consolidate and post a final owner map to Confluence at /sec/owner-maps/payments-kms.
Tess Ops: :thumbsup: sounds good.
security-bot: Evidence collector updated for SEC-4981. Uploads: https://uploads.redwood/sec-evidence/SEC-4981
Mike Barker: noted. I'll post evidence links here once queries complete (and attach grep output).
Sarah Choi: Thanks all. Action items recap: Tess — validate 3 entries; Mike — validate 4 entries and paste logs; Devon — mediate and publish owner map; Sarah — follow-up prune ticket and timeline. Deadline: Thu EOD. :white_check_mark:
